name: Reader
description: Copy the text out of any part of your screen: drag over it and it is in your clipboard.
author: Giuseppe
details: Copy the text out of anything you can see: an image, a video, a PDF, a window that doesn't let you select. Click the button, drag over the text and it is in your clipboard, read on your Mac with the built-in text recognition. The picture is deleted at once and nothing leaves your Mac.
features: Copy text from any part of the screen
A popup says how many words it found
permissions: macOS asks for Screen Recording the first time.
